review: I'm a bit confused about whether this is a cleanser or shower gel, it seems to be trying to be both. I ordered this to use as a facial cleanser when I want a cleanser with no actives in, but when it arrived I was surprised to see multiple sulfate-based surfactants which can be quite drying. It does try to compensate for this using other hydrating ingredients, but on dry skin this product may leave skin feeling tight. I'd also avoid this if you have sensitive skin. After one use this caused quite a big a big break out for me so I will only use on my body going forward. This would probably be ok on the face for oily and non-sensitive skin.Overall it seems ok quality and good value, but I'd recommend it for body use rather than than facial.

title: Quality hydrating shower gel
date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 21 June 2026
review: This is a nice refreshing shower gel to use. It is designed to hydrate the skin, and in this aspect I think it is successful. I get dry skin on my arms and legs after showering, and I found this didn't exacerbate it. The fragrance is light, fresh, and slightly chemically, but not at all unpleasant.Worth noting, it doesn't really lather much. So I end up using more than I would normally. I'd say I used about 10 pumps for a shower, so the implication is this will run down quite quickly. Just as well it's a litre bottle. It's a great effort, and I think represented good value for money. I love that it is made in France, so hasn't had far to come.Useful for all skin types, and a good quality hydrating gel all round.

title: Good size but is scented
date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 12 June 2026
review: This is a very large 1 litre bottle cleansing gel which is suitable to be used on the face and the body. The bottle does arrive with a pump attached to it, so you can easily dispense the gel from the bottle and the amount that you require.The cleansing gel is a clear and a runny consistency. The scent of the gel reminds me it of aftershave however; it is a clean pleasant scent which isn’t to overpowering but would have preferred a different type of scent.This cleansing gel is soap free and has more of a low lather to it so I do feel that I am using quite a bit more product than I actually required seeing and experiencing the lather more.Overall, I found this cleansing gel really refreshing on my skin; it was very gentle and didn’t cause any irritation. I think this bottle size offers really good value for the volume of product and will take me months to get through.

title: Superb giant size cleanser

review: This extra rich dermatological gel is a proper cracking product for anyone looking for a no fuss everyday face and body wash. The pump dispenser is highly practical on the bathroom shelf and one bottle lasts for months even with regular multi surface usage. It thoroughly cleanses sweat and dirt without irritating delicate skin barriers in the slightest. On the downside you should definitely look elsewhere if you want a multi tasking product that clears away evening makeup. The texture is far too mild to break down tinted sunscreens or heavy powders leaving a residue behind if not paired with a dedicated cleanser. It does its primary job of basic washing beautifully but know its limitations

This is obviously not cheap but to have a product that is suitable for sensitive skin is quite important to avoid daily skin irritation. I am pleased with it and will continue to use it.To help you assess my review, here is my star rating scale:5 stars: I really love the product and would happily recommend to friends and family.4 stars: I like it but it has some minor flaws or just not super special. title: The best product for atopic skin
date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 7 November 2025
review: The Uriage Extra-Rich Dermatological Cleansing Gel has become one of my go-to products for daily cleansing. I have dry, sensitive skin, and most cleansers tend to leave it tight or irritated — but this one does the complete opposite.It has a lovely light foaming texture that cleanses the skin thoroughly without stripping it of moisture. My skin feels fresh, soft, and comfortable after every wash. I love that it’s soap-free, paraben-free, and enriched with Uriage Thermal Water, which helps protect the skin’s natural hydrolipidic film and maintain long-lasting hydration.It works beautifully for both face and body, making it a practical and gentle all-in-one product. Even during times when my skin feels extra dry or sensitive, this cleansing gel never causes irritation — it actually helps calm and balance my skin.The 500ml size is generous and lasts a long time, so it’s great value for the quality you get.Overall, this is a fantastic gentle cleanser for anyone with dry, sensitive, or easily irritated skin. It leaves the skin clean, soft, and hydrated — I’ll definitely keep repurchasing it.

title: My absolute all-time favorite! Heavenly scent and perfect for sensitive skin

review: If I could only use one cleanser for the rest of my life, it would hands-down be the Uriage Extra-Rich Dermatological Face & Body Wash. It has a beautiful, clean, and refreshing fragrance that makes every shower feel like a luxurious spa experience, yet it is gentle enough that it never irritates my sensitive skin.The formula itself is brilliant. Because it is soap-free, paraben-free, and formulated at a physiological pH, it creates a gorgeous, fresh foam that cleanses thoroughly without stripping the skin. It truly preserves the skin's natural hydrolipidic film. Usually, body washes leave my skin feeling tight and itchy, but this extra-rich gel leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated, incredibly soft, and comfortable from head to toe.I love that it is a versatile, giant bottle of comfort that works perfectly for both the face and body. If you have sensitive, dry, or easily irritated skin and want something that smells amazing while keeping your skin barrier perfectly protected, you need to try this. I will never be without a bottle!
